name: Hermes Agent v0.21.7
body:
# Hermes Agent v0.21.7

**Release Date:** October 11, 2026

> Patch release. This tag rolls up the ~204 PRs merged since v0.21.6 into a stable release for the desktop app (macOS Apple silicon, Windows), the Microsoft Store and MSIX, the installer, Docker and Hermes Cloud. Full curated notes for this window ship with v0.22.0.

<!-- HERMES_BUILDS_TABLE -->

**What this patch ships for source installs (`hermes update` and the desktop app's updater on a git checkout):**

- **Updates now follow tagged releases.** A source install of the official repository updates to the latest published `vX.Y.Z` release instead of every commit on `main`. An install already newer than the latest release stays where it is and waits for the next one; nothing is moved back. To keep following every commit: `hermes update --set-channel main`. Forks and mirrors keep following `main`. Store, MSIX and bundled desktop installs are unchanged.
- **Choose the channel in the desktop app.** Settings ▸ About ▸ Updates has an *Update channel* switch (Stable releases / Every commit) for source installs, and the update dialog now shows which channel you are on.
- **Reasoning survives resume.** Signed thinking replays after `hermes chat --resume` and on the next gateway turn, and Bedrock Converse reasoning models no longer get rejected on resumed sessions.
- **Updates no longer fail behind some firewalls.** Installs on `main` no longer fetch a release record that regional firewalls could answer with 403. The stable check uses your GitHub token when one is set (`GITHUB_TOKEN` or `gh auth login`) and reports a GitHub rate limit as a rate limit.

## About this release

Measured at commit `1fd18277267152893a8a24792b79213e7ca3f899`, the window since v0.21.6 contains **740 non-merge commits** across **4,156 changed files** (+86,775 / −26,980), **204 merged PRs** and **69 closed issues**.

Also in the window, undocumented here on purpose: plugins running built-in Desktop app actions (`ctx.runAction`) and a plugin SDK pet bubble (`ctx.pet.say`); core-made Codex requests so plugins never hold the token; skills installed mid-session reaching the model without a prompt rebuild; Krea 2 Medium Turbo as the default image lane for new paid subscribers, with a FAL fallback when managed Krea refuses a request; faster desktop updates (the React Compiler pass cached by content, the compiled renderer reused when only the install stamp changed, unchanged native inputs left in place); pinned installs that check out only the pin; compaction marks emitted to Relay; and new community plugins including memory-shield, command-ledger, Memoria, Model Router, wyoming-voice-bridge, codex-account-switch and redline.

**Full curated release notes for this window ship with v0.22.0**, which will document everything from v0.21.0 onward — highlights, feature areas, and complete contributor credits. Nothing in this window is skipped.

## Updating

- Desktop app: updates itself. Microsoft Store installs update through the Store.
- CLI: `hermes update`, or re-run the installer one-liner.
- Docker / Hermes Cloud: `nousresearch/hermes-agent:stable` (or `:latest`).

**Full Changelog**: [v0.21.6...v0.21.7](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/compare/v0.21.6...v0.21.7)

body:
# HyperFrames v0.8.150

Released on 2026-10-12.

Video frame injection now releases replaced image resources, keeping render memory from growing with every frame. Composition-wide audio effects and scene export fixes also ship in this release.

## Compatibility notes

- A top-level composition root's `data-fx-chain` now processes the whole audio mix. Remove a previously unused root chain if you want unchanged audio. [#5420](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5420)
- For engine API users, `injectVideoFramesBatch` assigns temporary image URLs that expire after decoding. Use the original frame source when serializing or reloading the DOM. [#5494](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5494)

## Features

- Apply one audio effects chain across the whole composition, after clip and group effects. Set `data-fx-chain` on the top-level root. [#5420](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5420)

## Fixes

- Exported video and audio now respect split scenes' in-points and inline scenes' start times, matching their placement in preview. [#5454](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5454)
- A scene previewed or rendered alone uses its own master audio chain. [#5474](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5474)
- Pitch-shifted exports keep the end of the clip and its effect tail. Bitcrush preview no longer starts with a silent hold after seeking. [#5478](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5478)
- Studio history diagnostics include the server status and reason when an edit cannot be recorded as an undo step. [#5489](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5489)

## Performance

- Replaced video frames no longer accumulate cached image resources during capture. Engine-owned capture pages also retain less response data for DevTools inspection. [#5494](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5494)
- Large audio effects mixes render in windows instead of loading the full mix into the browser. Parameter automation above 2 GiB remains unsupported. [#5474](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5474)

## Catalog

- The `product-promo` example no longer fails lint on conflicting CSS and GSAP transforms, allowing its browser audits to run. [#5481](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5481)

## Full changelog

Released on 2026-10-11.

Apps can now import `transcribe` and `removeBackground` from `hyperframes/api` and call them as plain functions. They return typed results and throw typed errors, so tools like HyperFrames Desktop no longer need to run the CLI as a child process.

name: v0.7.3
body:
GPUI Kit v0.7.3 replaces v0.7.2, which is yanked: it contains every v0.7.2 change and moves GPUI to the gpui-pre 0.3.9 snapshot. Upgrade from v0.7.1 or v0.7.2 directly to v0.7.3.

This release adds a readonly Diff viewer with a Git history example, an optional GPUI Fast backend, and configurable dialog entrances. It refreshes TextView typography and improves text selection, Editor completions, tables, menus, tooltips and accessibility, and stops several per-frame state writes that made long scrolling views rebuild.

## New components and runtime

- **Diff**: display application-supplied unified or Git patches with the virtualized, readonly `Diff` view. `DiffFile::parse` prepares each file and one `DiffState` shows them all, with Unified or Split layout (`DiffMode`), syntax highlighting, folding, change navigation, inline word or character emphasis, soft wrapping, annotations, and two-way or diff3 conflict display. Applications own patch loading, review comments and saving. ([#3378](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3378))
- **Git history example**: `examples/tig` is a desktop Git history browser built on Diff, with a resizable commit and file sidebar, Split layout and a settings menu; the Diff review APIs it needed are complete. ([#3388](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3388))
- **GPUI snapshot**: exact snapshot dependencies are updated to `=0.3.9` (zed@93d7456), and the optional GPUI Fast backend requires `gpui-fast` 0.1.7 on the same snapshot. ([#3459](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3459))
- **GPUI Fast backend**: enable the optional `gpui-fast` feature (`gpui-kit = { version = "0.7", features = ["gpui-fast"] }`) to run on GPUI Fast instead of the default gpui-pre backend. Imports and macros are unchanged, and Windows applications embed a single manifest. ([#3375](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3375), [#3380](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3380))
- **Fewer rebuilds**: selectable text, the text selection layer, `Root`, inputs, `TextViewState` and resizable panels no longer write state on frames where nothing changed, so retained views under GPUI Fast stay on their scroll layer. ([#3407](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3407), [#3418](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3418))

## Editor and text input

- **On-demand completions**: dispatch the Editor-only `ShowCompletions` action or call `show_completions` to request suggestions from a command, menu or application shortcut; no default shortcut is bound. ([#3411](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3411))
- **Programmatic multi-cursor**: `InputState::add_selection` adds a selection while keeping the existing ones, enabling features such as select all occurrences. ([#3403](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3403))
- **Context menus**: an input keeps its selection and focus ring while its context menu is open, and submenus inherit the parent menu's `action_context`, so actions such as Select All reach the source Textarea. Custom `on_context_menu` builders now run after the input is released and can read its cursor and text. ([#3382](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3382), [#3433](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3433))
- Fixed completion and code-action popups lagging one frame behind the caret, and auto-grow Textareas collapsing to `min_rows` after `set_auto_grow` changes the limits. ([#3412](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3412), [#3430](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3430))

## Markdown and text rendering

- **Typography**: TextView headings build hierarchy with weight, sizes and spacing scale with the inherited font size, and lists, code, links and tables are more restrained. See Behavior changes. ([#3371](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3371))
- **Selection**: mouse selections include block `MarkdownPlugin` content as whole blocks, completed selections survive style, zoom and width changes, and the selection paints under the glyphs so opaque selection colors keep text readable. ([#3373](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3373), [#3390](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3390), [#3421](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3421), [#3439](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3439))
- **Tables**: narrow columns size from measured text width and stay on one line, and rounded table frames keep clean corners at any horizontal scroll offset. `RoundedFrameCover` is available for application frames with their own rounded scroll viewports. ([#3399](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3399), [#3309](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3309), [#3400](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3400))
- Fixed inline `<mark>` highlights in Markdown, including `color` and `background-color` attributes. ([#3425](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3425))

## Components

- **Dialog**: choose an entrance with `entrance(DialogEntrance::Fade)`, `FadeSlide`, `None` or the default `SlideDown` on `Dialog` and `AlertDialog`; `AlertDialog::margin_top` moves an alert off the default top offset. ([#3405](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3405), [#3404](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3404))
- **Tooltip**: install `TooltipDefaults` to set the application-wide show delay and grace period, or override one trigger with `tooltip_show_delay`. ([#3376](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3376))
- **DataTable**: `header_row_height` sets header rows apart from body rows; the sort icon is a labelled button; `visible_rows_changed` reports one-row and empty tables; a right-clicked cell's outline clears on the next click, exposed through `TableState::right_clicked_cell`. ([#3420](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3420), [#3396](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3396), [#3397](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3397), [#3413](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3413))
- **ContextMenu**: a long press opens the menu on touch devices, and the menu takes focus before its first frame, avoiding a debug-build abort with accessibility active. ([#3393](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3393), [#3422](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3422))
- **TabBar**: clicking a clipped tab scrolls it into view with the next tab peeking. ([#3419](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3419))
- **Dock**: closing the focused tab hands focus to the tab that replaces it. ([#3409](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3409))
- **DropdownButton**: `menu_accessibility_label` names the caret-only menu trigger, with a localized "More options" default. ([#3410](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3410))
- **Settings**: focus rings stay inside the list viewport. ([#3394](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3394))
- **UI tests**: `Progress`, `ProgressCircle` and `TitleBar` can be found with `TestWindowExt::find`. ([#3383](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3383))

## Documentation

- **Focus and dialogs**: the guides explain recovering focus when the focused element stops rendering, and the `open_dialog` builder and footer contracts. ([#3386](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3386), [#3406](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3406))

## Behavior changes

TextView renders with new default typography. Heading sizes follow the inherited font size, the paragraph gap is `0.75rem` (was `1rem`), and list, inline code, link and table cell styling change. The paragraph gap, headings and code blocks can be restored through the existing style hooks. ([#3371](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3371))

```diff
 TextViewStyle::default()
+    .paragraph_gap(rems(1.))
```

Table column widths in the default wrap layout change for most Markdown tables. A drag that starts and ends inside the same block plugin no longer selects it. ([#3399](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3399), [#3390](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3390))

While a context menu is open, focus that the application moves elsewhere is no longer pulled back to the menu. ([#3422](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3422))

`TableDelegate::visible_rows_changed` now fires with `0..1` for a one-row table and `0..0` when the rows drop to none, and its end never passes `rows_count`. ([#3397](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3397))

`TooltipRequest::placement` is deprecated in favor of `with_placement`. ([#3376](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3376))

```diff
- TooltipRequest::new(bounds, build).placement(Placement::Right)
+ TooltipRequest::new(bounds, build).with_placement(Placement::Right)
```

Thank you to everyone who contributed code, documentation, testing, and feedback!

name: v18.10.2
body:
## @oh-my-pi/pi-agent-core

### Added

- Added `AgentLoopConfig.onDetachedToolUpdate`: a tool's `onUpdate` frames that arrive after its run's event stream ended (a returned call whose background job keeps reporting) reach it instead of being dropped; `Agent` forwards them to its subscribers as `tool_execution_update` events

## @oh-my-pi/pi-ai

### Added

- Added support for `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_BETAS` on the `anthropic` provider: when set, requests omit pre-release fields (`context_management`, beta tool fields such as `strict` and `defer_loading`, task budgets, structured-output format, `thinking.block_binding`, and Anthropic server compaction) along with their beta headers, so `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` gateways that reject them keep working ([#15458](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15458) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-catalog

### Added

- Added the `honors-claude-code-beta-kill-switch` axis (`compat.honorsClaudeCodeBetaKillSwitch`), on for the `anthropic` provider, so a rule or `models.yml` override decides which providers honor `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_BETAS` ([#15458](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15458) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent

### Added

- Added `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_BETAS` support: set it to stop Anthropic requests sending experimental beta fields that a company `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` gateway rejects, such as the Sonnet 5.5 `thinking.adaptive.block_binding` 400 ([#15458](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15458) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC))
- Added the `task.structured` setting (default off) for structured task results: when on, the task tool accepts `outputSchema`/`schemaMode` and subagents return results through `yield` as before

### Changed

- Subagents spawned by the task tool now return their final message as plain text, with no `yield` tool, output schemas, or "Submit Result" fields; eval `agent()`/workpool spawns still return structured results
- In Tern, a backgrounded `bash` command or `eval` cell keeps filling its own card with live output (In background, with a running clock) and settles it with the job's outcome, Cancelled when the job is killed; `wait` lists each job on one line (type, id, label, duration) instead of repeating its output
- ACP clients now see a backgrounded call's job output stream into its tool call, which settles completed or failed with the job

### Fixed

- Fails unstructured task runs that conclude without a final message
- Background task cards no longer stop updating once the agent ends its turn while the task is still running
- Transparent images the model receives (small icons, oversized screenshots) keep their transparency instead of turning into a black square, and resized edges no longer pick up a dark fringe

## @oh-my-pi/pi-natives

### Added

- Added in-process `env`, `du`, `chmod`, `fold`, `rmdir`, `od`, `df`, `uptime`, `id`, and `dd` shell builtins matching GNU coreutils 9.x options, output, and exit codes (`chmod` and `id` on Unix only; `dd` is disabled with the destructive set by `PI_DISABLE_UUTILS_DESTRUCTIVE`).
- Added an in-process `nl` shell builtin (ported from uutils coreutils 0.8.0, matching GNU `nl`), with header/body/footer numbering styles including `pBRE` regex styles, logical-page section delimiters, `-l` blank-line grouping, and `ln`/`rn`/`rz` number formats.

## @oh-my-pi/pi-tui

### Added

- Added opt-in `/tree` branch navigation across visible branches and nested fork depths; bind `app.tree.previousBranch` / `app.tree.nextBranch` (e.g. to `Shift+Left` / `Shift+Right`) in `keybindings.yml` ([#12623](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/12623) by [@azain47](https://github.com/azain47)).

### Changed

- The `wait` tool's native job rows (`omp.wait.job`) are a single `row`: badge, id and label, progress and clock, without the output preview or capture notice beneath
- The native bash run foot reads In background with a live clock (`omp.run.time` without `stopped`) while a parked job's frames stream (`details.async.state === "running"`, partial), instead of Running
- Native model pickers (/model, the quick switch and the advisor's) mark providers with their logo (`mark.icon: "provider:<id>"`, initials where the terminal has none), and every model row leads with its provider's mark

### Removed

- Removed the unused `app.tree.foldOrUp` / `app.tree.unfoldOrDown` keybinding ids, which no longer did anything.
- Added `parksAsBackground(toolName, details)`, `asyncJobState(details)`, `isSettledJobFrame(details)` and `settleWithJobFrame(component, frame, toolCallId)` (`chat/tool-execution`): whether a returned call's card stays live for its background job's frames (`task` always; `bash` and `eval` under native rendering), the job state a frame reports, and settling the card with the job's last frame (a cancelled job keeps its output and seals as cancelled)
- `BashToolDetails.async.state` and `EvalToolDetails.async.state` gain `cancelled` for a job killed before it finished

## @oh-my-pi/pi-wire

### Added

- Added `TspPickerMark.icon`: an icon a picker mark draws instead of its initials when the terminal has it (`provider:<id>` names a model provider's logo)


## What's Changed
* feat(tui): jump across session tree branches by @azain47 in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/12623
* feat(ai): honor CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_BETAS for anthropic gateways by @H4vC in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15458


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/compare/v18.10.1...v18.10.2

name: v18.10.1
body:
## @oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent

### Added

- Added a Copy button that leads the turn footer under an answer in Tern (`⧉ · 2m13s · 71K tok · $0.85 this turn`, in place of the clock), which copies that answer

### Changed

- Running agents and background jobs in Tern now share one compact counter over the composer (an icon and a count each, the words on hover) instead of two "N running" pills; each count still opens its own sheet
- In Tern, `/session pin` and `/usage reset` open the same picker sheet as the other small selectors (the active account checked, a confirm strip before a reset is spent, unusable accounts dimmed with the reason); the thinking level picker shows each level's depth as a meter, the plugin and queue mode pickers use badges (version, installed, scope, recommended) and plain-language names instead of bracketed text, and the theme picker no longer repeats "(current)" beside its check
- In Tern, the text editor an extension opens (and the ask tool's custom answer and note) is now a sheet in the composer's place: the title over its details, the text written straight on the sheet, and Open in editor, Cancel and Submit buttons whose keys show in their tooltips instead of a keycap hint row

### Fixed

- Fixed `grep` on a single file showing in Tern as separate boxed snippets with no file row or syntax colors; it now looks the same as a `grep` over a directory

## @oh-my-pi/pi-tui

### Added

- `AssistantMessageComponent`'s native turn footer leads with a Copy icon (`omp.turn.copy`) and a dot instead of the clock icon; it copies the answer's text and shows when the host handles transcript actions

### Changed

- `UserMessageComponent`'s native hover toolbar (`omp.user.tools`) leads with Copy and Rewind icon buttons (`copy`, `rewind`) instead of text labels, then a dot and the time, like the turn usage footer
- `ContextUsageView`'s native body (on terminals with `meter`) leads with the tokens used and the room left before auto-compaction, then one stacked bar ticked at the threshold, the breakdown as rows (`omp.context.cat`, `.cat.free`, `.cat.buffer`: swatch, name, tokens, share; the exact count in the row's `title`) and the snapcompact estimate as labelled rows (`omp.context.snap`); the blocks meter and legend `kv` are gone, and `contextUsageHead` no longer repeats the window size
- `AskDialogComponent`'s native root is `omp.editor.ask` (collapsed: `omp.editor.ask.hidden`, the countdown, the question as `omp.ask.summary`, Skip and Show): a chosen answer is the `accent`-toned row (a check also carries the check icon) instead of the highlighted one; multi-select Other… is `omp.ask.other.check`; the question tabs check answered questions and say their keys in the strip's `title`; the countdown moves from the head to the action bar beside Hide; the preview is `omp.ask.preview`; the Review tab leads with `omp.ask.notice` and lists answers (`omp.ask.answers`) by question name with inline code mono and no `(Recommended)` suffix; option descriptions run inline code mono, notes ride the row's detail as `em`; Submit/Next's tooltip names only Enter (and Space on a multi-select)
- `MCPAddWizard`'s native sheet asks one question per step: a phase strip (`omp.mcpAdd.progress` of `omp.mcpAdd.phase`, toned done/current/upcoming and `neutral` when no auth was needed), the question and its lead (`omp.mcpAdd.title`, `omp.mcpAdd.tag` for optional fields, `omp.mcpAdd.lead`), then a mono field with a placeholder and its rule or refusal (`omp.mcpAdd.field`, `tone: "error"`; `omp.mcpAdd.note`), choice rows with icons and mono tags (`omp.mcpAdd.choices`), status lines (`omp.mcpAdd.status`, `omp.mcpAdd.checks`, `omp.mcpAdd.error`) or the review rows (`omp.mcpAdd.summary`). Cancel, Back and Continue / Save server buttons run Ctrl+C, Esc and Enter instead of a key-hint strip. The connection test shows its own busy step, the OAuth client secret field is masked, and the review saves on Enter (no Yes/No choice)
- `ReportPanel`'s native body carries the role `omp.report.body`
- `HookInputComponent` describes a dock sheet (`omp.overlay.hook-input` col) like `HookEditorComponent`'s: the title's first line (`omp.hook-input.title`, the countdown as `omp.hook-input.timer`) over its further lines (`omp.hook-input.detail`), the field (`omp.hook-input.field`, `tone: "error"` while a submit was refused) with its placeholder, and Cancel / Submit buttons that run Esc / Enter; the key legend under the field is terminal-only
- `JobsSheet`'s native body is a master–detail split (`omp.jobs.split`: `omp.jobs.master` | `omp.jobs.detail`): the job list grouped Running / Recent (`omp.jobs.group` labels), each row a type icon tinted by status with its duration, beside the selected job's status pill, live elapsed and Cancel job (`omp.jobs.status`), its task title or command (`omp.jobs.title` / `omp.jobs.command`), facts (`omp.jobs.facts`: agent, directory, pids, exit code, artifact) and output (`omp.jobs.out`, `omp.jobs.nooutput`); the footer counts running and recent jobs (`omp.jobs.summary`), and no jobs shows an empty state (`omp.jobs.empty`). Task jobs no longer draw an `agent` node here
- `BtwHistoryPanel`'s native sheet is centered and reads like a mail reader: the questions as two-line rows (`omp.btw.history`, list `omp.btw.list` / `omp.btw.list.idle` while the answer has the keys) beside the selected thread (`omp.btw.reader` › `omp.btw.thread` › `omp.btw.turn`: `omp.btw.question` / `omp.btw.followup`, `omp.btw.meta`, `omp.btw.answer`, `omp.btw.error`), the follow-up field under the last answer (`omp.btw.composer`), and footer buttons Stop answer, Copy answer, Close and Follow up (Cancel and Send while composing) in place of the focus labels and key-hint strip; an empty history is an `md` sheet (`omp.btw.empty`)

### Fixed

- `CountdownTimer`'s native `elapsed` no longer sends `stopped: 0`, which froze every native countdown (extension input, selector and editor prompts) at zero from the start
- The native backend's focus now reaches a field inside an `overlay`/`picker` sheet hoisted into the layer from a dock component (the MCP add wizard, login), so that field shows the live caret and focus ring
- `MCPAddWizard` keeps a refused name or URL in its field, clears a stale refusal on Back, ignores a connection test that settles after the user stepped back, and Edit OAuth settings after a failed sign-in opens the settings again instead of doing nothing

name: v18.10.0
body:
## @oh-my-pi/pi-catalog

### Changed

- Raised the default context window for `openai-codex/gpt-6.1-sol` and `gpt-6.1-sol-wm` from 272K to 500K, matching OpenAI's new Codex default; extended context still opens 922K ([#15421](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15421))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent

### Added

- Added `/fork` support for creating a new Tern pane while a turn is streaming, preserving the original session
- Added `omp session pack`, `omp session unpack` and `omp session moved` to move a session with its artifacts to another machine and continue it there; resuming the copy left behind forks it instead of continuing it
- Added `omp auth export` and `omp auth import` to carry model sign-ins to another machine
- Added hiding a pending `ask` question without answering it: `Alt+H` (`app.ask.hide`) or the Hide button in Tern collapses the dialog to one line; the same key, `Enter`, or Show brings it back ([#15400](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15400) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC))

### Changed

- Local IPC endpoints (daemon broker, LSP mux, IDA hosts, text prediction, `omp stream`, Collab discovery, local model workers) now run on a native transport: owner-only on every platform, including Windows named pipes; on Windows, daemons started by an older omp are not reused, so close older sessions after upgrading.
- Output hidden behind an open `ask` dialog, command report or todo list now reaches terminal scrollback once it closes, rather than while it is still open ([#15405](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15405) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC))

### Fixed

- Fixed every session loading its own copy of the local mnemopi embedding model and keeping it in memory until exit; one server per model is shared across sessions and exits after 15 idle minutes ([#9908](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/9908))
- Fixed the first-use mnemopi embedding-model download never completing for sessions shorter than the download; it now finishes in the shared embedding server after the session exits ([#10240](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/10240))
- Fixed `RpcClient.stop()` occasionally waiting forever because the agent process was never signaled.
- Fixed blank rows opening under the input after an `ask` dialog, command report or todo list closed in a session that had filled the screen; the transcript now refills the screen ([#15405](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15405) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC))
- Fixed blank rows appearing between the last paragraphs of a streamed answer when the turn ended ([#15405](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15405) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-natives

### Added

- Added `IpcServer`, `IpcConnection`, and `ipcEndpoint`: a local IPC transport over Unix sockets and Windows named pipes with owner-only access, single-instance binding, stale-endpoint takeover, and newline framing.

### Changed

- Optimized transport performance with task-local write coalescing and batch-based newline processing

## @oh-my-pi/pi-tui

### Breaking Changes

- Removed `RuntimeChildrenOptions.transient` and `Component.retireDisplacedTranscript`: the composer now bills all chrome below the transcript at the smallest height it has rendered, so no root opts in or out ([#15405](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15405) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC))

### Added

- Added the `app.ask.hide` keybinding (default `Alt+H`) and Hide/Show actions on `AskDialogComponent`, which collapse the dialog to a single line while its question stays pending ([#15400](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15400) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC))

### Changed

- The `OMP_TUI_DEBUG` control socket now uses the native IPC transport: it is owner-only and no longer replaces a socket another live process is serving.
- Transcript rows pushed aside by an open dialog, report or HUD now reach scrollback when it closes or newer output pushes them out, instead of while it is open ([#15405](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15405) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC))
- A transcript block straddling the top of the screen now sends only its off-screen rows to scrollback; the rest stays live ([#15405](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15405) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC))

### Fixed

- Fixed blank rows opening under the editor after an ask or other inline dialog, command report or todo/loader HUD closed in a session that had filled the screen; the screen now refills with the transcript ([#15405](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15405) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC))
- Fixed the editor rising above blank rows when a live tool preview collapses under scrolled-off output; it now stays on the bottom row ([#15405](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15405) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC))
- Fixed blank rows opening inside a streamed answer when the working loader went away at the end of a turn ([#15405](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15405) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC))
- Fixed a split transcript block dropping punctuation-only rows it reveals after the split (such as a tool pane's rule line on expand); the seam now stops before them instead of treating them as already committed ([#15420](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15420) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC))
- Fixed a split transcript block fingerprinting measured rows instead of the bytes committed to scrollback, which could duplicate a SIXEL image prefix once its pending encode landed ([#15420](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15420) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC))
- Fixed a transcript block straddling the top of the screen losing its off-screen rows when the inline-image limit demoted its images to text in the same frame; those rows now reach scrollback as text

### Removed

- Removed `Composer.pinInputToBottom()`; the composer keeps the input on the bottom row by itself ([#15405](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15405) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-utils

### Added

- Added `getMnemopiEmbedRuntimeDir()` for the shared mnemopi embedding server endpoints and logs.

### Fixed

- Fixed `ChildProcess.kill()` silently leaving the child running when the native process handle could not be resolved or used; it now signals the child directly and escalates to SIGKILL after the grace period.


## What's Changed
* feat(tui): hide a pending ask dialog without answering by @H4vC in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15400
* fix(tui): keep the transcript filling the screen when chrome below it shrinks by @H4vC in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15405
* fix(tui): harden row-split seam relocation and fingerprint by @H4vC in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15420

## @oh-my-pi/pi-agent-core

### Changed

- Improved context caching for repeat turns, reducing redundant prompt processing and making subsequent turns faster when the system prompt is unchanged.

## @oh-my-pi/pi-ai

### Breaking Changes

- Renamed `TypeSafeJudge` to `NativeJudge` and `TypeSafeApiError` to `JudgmentApiError`, including their associated option types. `JUDGMENT_ROUTES` has been removed; use `isJudgmentApi` or create a judge for catalog models with `createNativeJudge(model, { apiKey })`.

### Added

- Added native judge support for OpenAI’s Decisions API and Cloudflare Workers AI decision models, including the `openai-decisions` and `workers-ai-systemone` APIs. The auth gateway’s System One route supports both providers.
- Added `createNativeJudge(model, { apiKey, headers, fetch })` for creating judges from catalog models with their configured request model IDs and question limits.
- Added Cloudflare Workers AI authentication with `loginCloudflareWorkersAi`, storing the API token and account ID; logging in again with the same token replaces the existing credential.
- Added automatic question batching to `NativeJudge` for endpoints with question limits, with up to four concurrent batches and merged answers and usage reporting. Usage from successful batches is reported through partial-usage callbacks and both session and auth-gateway usage ledgers, even if another batch fails.

### Changed

- Improved Anthropic prompt caching for long conversations, reducing memory usage while selecting cache breakpoints.

### Fixed

- Fixed Devin-routed OpenAI models returning `invalid_argument` on every turn after an existing session was switched from `openai-codex`.

## @oh-my-pi/pi-catalog

### Removed

- Removed `parseCloudflareAiGatewayCredential`, `serializeCloudflareAiGatewayCredential`, and `CloudflareAiGatewayCredential` from `@oh-my-pi/pi-catalog/wire/cloudflare-ai-gateway`. Use the equivalents from `@oh-my-pi/pi-catalog/wire/cloudflare` instead.

## @oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent

### Fixed

- Improved responsiveness when adding assistant text after tool calls in long transcripts.
- Fixed `apply_patch` handling of context-free hunks when the target text appears multiple times.
- Fixed `find` filename ranking and sketch scoring with judge endpoints that limit the number of questions per request.
- Fixed `omp gc --apply` leaving temporary session files after an interrupted save.
- Fixed `omp auth-gateway serve` handling of OpenRouter routing variants such as `:floor` and `:nitro`.
- Improved validation errors for `computer` helpers with missing or non-string text arguments by identifying the helper and argument involved.
- Fixed `/tan` forks incorrectly inheriting the parent task's subagent spending while preserving token counts.
- Fixed `omp://` documentation links so they open the corresponding files in source checkouts.
- Fixed bare model IDs in `models.yml` incorrectly resolving to auto-discovered Ollama, llama.cpp, or LM Studio providers.
- Added warnings when configured Ollama, llama.cpp, or LM Studio endpoints cannot be reached, identifying the relevant environment variable.

## @oh-my-pi/pi-natives

### Fixed

- Fixed stalls when highlighting Markdown tool previews containing many inline spans or backslash escapes.

## @oh-my-pi/pi-tui

### Added

- Added native TSP rendering support for Tern terminal sessions running inside tmux, with automatic session detection and safe title-setting behavior.

### Fixed

- Improved responsiveness when inserting assistant messages after tool calls in long transcripts.

## @oh-my-pi/pi-utils

### Changed

- Improved streaming JSON parsing performance for tool arguments containing many string values.

### Fixed

- Fixed parsing of long strings that contain closing delimiters other than double or single quotes.

name: Reasonix Studio v2.37.0
body:
本版加入常用服务预设库和主题包删除，并修复严格网关回放无参数工具调用时的 HTTP 400、卡住的外壳探测拖住内核等问题。

## 新增

- 添加模型服务时可以从内核维护的常用预设开始：可搜索、按域名分组，选中后整条预设（模型目录、识图模型、窗口、思考档）原样写入，名称重复由内核判断 (#12645)
- 外观里可以删除已安装的主题包，需要点两次确认，内置主题没有删除入口 (#12623)

## 变更

- 删除模型服务时会说明哪些角色改用了其他服务、哪些被清空，并从 `provider_access` 里去掉该服务 (#12589)
- 带密钥的供应商请求（聊天、探测、余额、决策协议）不再跟随跨主机的重定向；被拒时说明被重定向到了哪里，聊天也不再重试十次。如果你的中转站会重定向，把 base URL 改成它重定向到的地址即可 (#12570)
- 每天的第一个回合会告诉模型当天日期，只放在回合末尾，不改变缓存前缀 (#12598)
- `reasonix upgrade` 遇到由 npm 或 Homebrew 安装的程序，会提示用对应的包管理器升级，不再自己替换文件 (#12578)
- 检查通过之后才写入的文档不再要求再验证一次；有工具钩子或边车介入时仍然要求验证 (#12560)

## 修复

- 严格的网关在回放无参数的工具调用时返回 HTTP 400「arguments must be valid JSON」：空参数现在发送 `{}`，已保存的会话保持原样 (#12745)
- 外壳探测整体有时限，一次卡住的探测不再拖住内核，也不会反复重新启动 (#12615)
- 本地 `.mcp.json` 等清单有大小上限，安装被拒时会写明具体原因 (#12641)
- 内部：Windows 更新助手移除、配置迁移合并为一次读取、启动输入显式绑定、测试稳定性 (#12594, #12592, #12555, #12742)

## What's Changed
* fix(providers): keep key-carrying provider requests on the configured origin by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12570
* fix(readiness): prose written after a passing check owes no second run by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12560
* feat(providers): report the roles a removal moved or cleared and prune provider_access by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12589
* feat(control): tell the model the calendar date on the turn tail, once per day by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12598
* feat(providers): offer the kernel's curated presets when adding a source by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12645
* fix(sandbox): bound shell discovery as a whole so a stalled lookup cannot hold the kernel handshake by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12615
* perf(config): run the retired-key migrations over one read of each config by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12592
* fix(installsource): bound a local .mcp.json and name the cause of a refused install by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12641
* perf(boot): bind every storage root Build resolves to its stated home by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12555
* fix(upgrade): leave npm-installed binaries to npm by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12578
* refactor(update): remove the unused Windows update helper from studio by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12594
* feat(studio): delete a theme pack from Appearance by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12623
* fix(provider): replay a tool call with no arguments as an empty object by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12745
* docs(release): Studio 2.37.0 notes by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12746
* fix(e2ebench): fail mutation and differential analysis when source restoration fails by @chuiwenwei in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12562
* fix(serve): send an empty sessions list for a folder with no conversations by @jipeng6036-del in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12744

## New Contributors
* @jipeng6036-del made their first contribution in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12744

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/compare/studio-v2.36.0...studio-v2.37.0

body:
本版加入提问等待超时、可选提示音、可选的折叠中间过程、每回合运行时长、改动文件条、工作区额外文件夹设置和编辑连接时更改协议，回执卡改为默认隐藏，并修复 1M 窗口每轮 400、存储迁移卡在校验、滚轮抖动、模型切换被后台任务挡住、Linux 与 Windows 更新等问题。

## 新增

- 新增可选的提问等待超时（默认关闭）：设置的会话页、`[agent] ask_timeout_seconds` 或终端 `/ask-timeout` 开启后，无人回答的提问超时即跳过，并告诉模型这是超时而非你的回答 (#12661)
- 每个回合结束后显示它运行了多久，重新载入历史后仍能看到；失败或被取消的回合不显示，旧会话也不补造 (#12656)
- 输入框上方新增改动文件条，显示「N 个文件已更改 +x -y」，点击打开工作台文件列表；默认开启，可在会话设置里关闭，非 git 工作区不显示 (#12668)
- 外观的行宽新增「整宽，输入框也铺满」，默认不变，需要时自己选；手机宽度不受影响 (#12703)

body:
## 2026.10.5-beta.2

### Highlights

- **Updates finish and recover:** `openclaw update` settles stale handoff leases, completed receipts, and legacy 2026.9.8 recovery records instead of stopping on `update-recovery-pending`, keeps the service heap limit and webhook listeners, handles Windows short-name paths, and no longer reports accepted handoffs or successful updates as failures. (#169038, #169027, #168388, #168889, #169035, #169292, #168927, #168993, #169037, #169454, #168905) Thanks @mkdelta221, @waynegault, @chedong, @k94118, @bluet, @sirius1024, @RomneyDa, @sayitfast, and @hannesrudolph.
- **Doctor keeps your plugins and data:** Doctor preserves installed plugins' configuration when path safety checks block them, leaves malformed UTF-8 root memory files untouched, and recovery copies capture Canvas and Memory Core files before migrations move them, including on installs with no configured agents. (#168111, #169029, #169436, #169516) Thanks @obviyus, @wangmiao0668000666, and @RomneyDa.
- **Approved tool calls stay as approved:** hooks can no longer change tool arguments after a trusted inline approval; plugins that transform arguments must request approval for their final arguments. (#142700) Thanks @giodl73-repo and @giodl73.
- **Subagent message provenance:** inter-session messages keep their `[Inter-session message]` safety envelope from the first request and through replay, so parent-sent instructions are never presented to a child as direct user instructions. (#169130, #169238) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- **Control UI turns keep running:** chat turns from paired devices survive ordinary pairing activity such as node heartbeats, other devices' updates, and tab reconnects; real revocations still stop them. (#169457, #169134) Thanks @Oldrich333.

### Changes

- **Tool approval hooks:** ordinary hooks can no longer rewrite trusted-inline-approved tool arguments without another approval, and transforming plugins must request separate approval for their final arguments or the call is blocked; see `docs/plugins/hooks/tool-policy.md` for migration. (#142700) Thanks @giodl73-repo and @giodl73.
- **Codex runtime compatibility:** plugin admission rejects official Codex runtimes below 2026.9.7 with update and repair guidance, and incompatible plugins stay inspectable without being imported. (#168930, #168748, #168749, #168977) Thanks @ezimerman.
- **Session notices:** creating many sessions gives the main session one summary of new sessions instead of separate notices that crowd out reminders and wakes. (#168239)
- **Update performance:** updates stop rehashing unchanged runtime files while retaining the running updater and publishing the candidate, reducing update I/O. (#168958)

### Fixes

- **Tool Search provenance:** network results reached through Tool Search and Code Mode now taint the turn the same way direct network tool calls do. (#169560, #169332) Thanks @RomneyDa and @farisoftfry.
- **Subagent provenance:** child sessions keep the inter-session safety envelope on every replayed turn, and inter-session turns keep a stable provider prompt prefix across later turns and Gateway restarts. (#169130, #169238) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- **Node commands and approvals:** approved node commands replay when their prepared plan omitted session identity, Windows node shell commands keep quoted arguments, safe-bin commands accept trailing whitespace, and the Linux node service keeps its PATH when the login shell resets it. (#161980, #151622, #158160, #142847, #168120, #136677, #134354) Thanks @Program-123, @gaojian125, @Dimitri-lcht, @igs-rogenlo, @yetval, @harjothkhara, and @abacha.
- **Private reasoning:** unfinished model reasoning stays private when a reply hits a token limit or content filter after a tool call. (#168294)
- **Doctor data safety:** Doctor keeps blocked plugins' authored entries, enablement, policy, and slots; refuses to merge malformed UTF-8 root memory; captures Canvas and Memory Core files in new recovery copies (and works on installs with no configured agents); skips redundant cron backups for unchanged one-shot jobs; and honors Windows permissions for SQLite recovery snapshots. (#168111, #168066, #169029, #168567, #169436, #169516, #168938, #168838, #169397) Thanks @obviyus, @wangmiao0668000666, @RomneyDa, @harshitgupta31415, and @WG-Mojo.
- **Memory:** daily-note flushes reject copied saved content instead of repeating blocks, and correcting an embedding provider's endpoint or credential refreshes cached index managers without a Gateway restart. (#168123, #151263, #151055) Thanks @ruel225 and @Mirksen.
- **Restart recovery:** main sessions that were mid-turn during a Gateway restart resume on the next boot, interrupted completion replies are delivered instead of lost, and new replies wait for their agent to finish starting instead of failing with `prepared reply dispatch runtime owner was not published`. (#168651, #167814, #167766, #168826, #157814) Thanks @goutamadwant, @marknilsn, and @xiaozishan.
- **Reply routing:** WebChat task completions stay in WebChat, mirrored external sends no longer change a transcript's reply destination, and Reef carries GitHub commit links without flagging their revision IDs as credentials. (#168248)
- **Prompt caching:** conversations whose first message ends in whitespace keep a byte-stable prompt prefix, and OpenAI-compatible and local endpoints keep runtime context in a user-role message. (#168725, #168546, #164791) Thanks @flanker-stack.
- **Compaction:** sessions skip a redundant host compaction after native-only compaction, safeguard compaction keeps configured AGENTS.md sections, and memory-flush runs keep provider-native compaction off. (#168051, #168015, #168446, #168131, #168164) Thanks @ruel225, @xydigitLybnnnn, @robertoronderosjr, @jakeaadams, and @obviyus.
- **Control UI:** chat turns survive unrelated pairing activity, typed `/stop` also cancels queued turns for the session, and open chats recover after a Gateway update or recovery reload instead of sticking on **Server updated → Retry now**, keeping their place. (#169457, #169134, #167860, #167859, #168941, #169194) Thanks @Oldrich333 and @masatohoshino.
- **Telegram:** polling connects again when the ingress worker runs from a source checkout or packaged plugin build, and tables next to quotes or lists keep their boundaries and values. (#154286, #154180, #168383, #168366) Thanks @xydt-juyaohui, @markfietje, @dhruv1220, and @barry-ssb.
- **Channels and voice:** channels start again after a stopped-Tailscale failure, the Matrix probe stops its client after checking identity, and `openclaw voicecall steer` keeps stdout machine-readable JSON. (#162266, #168587) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- **Agent turns:** scheduled and ordinary turns reach the configured fallback after a provider timeout, queued follow-ups that switch model clear the auto-fallback probe, cancelled queued CLI work never runs, empty stream heartbeats no longer count as model progress, malformed tool calls whose argument length is 401 or 403 are not reported as auth failures, valid tool argument union values keep their type, and plugin completions keep working after another plugin reloads. (#168605, #160440, #160428, #169303, #145850, #168500, #168450, #158974, #168916, #156026) Thanks @hxy91819, @changeroa, @RileyJJY, @TYY-2005, @r3n3x, @Shenrui-Ma, and @jalehman.
- **Claude CLI:** Claude CLI models stay listed after another plugin's config changes, exec-completion turns keep their native and MCP tools, and saved session MCP server selections apply on the next turn. (#168315, #168670, #168342, #168393, #168207) Thanks @obviyus, @Oldrich333, and @dprev.
- **OpenRouter prompt caching:** cache-TTL context pruning now arms for Grok and Gemini 2.5+ models on OpenRouter. (#169548, #169133) Thanks @RomneyDa and @gregb100.
- **Models and providers:** API-key sign-in discovers the provider's models immediately, shared OAuth credentials refresh with historical agent stores, switching back to an OpenAI model works without the Codex plugin, timed-out Codex discovery clients are reaped, LM Studio waits for slow model loads instead of overflowing a fresh session, and credential removal during a model reload no longer leaves a restart warning. (#168617, #168957, #169412, #168365, #168044) Thanks @obviyus.
- **Model catalog memory:** a long-running Gateway's model-catalog worker evaluates an unchanged installed native ESM plugin once per workspace instead of retaining another copy of its module graph on every config change, and a failed native refresh re-registers the requested config on the next request. (#169272, #169321, #159662) Thanks @obviyus, @mcooks-cmd, @RomneyDa, and @svdinu-jpg.
- **MCP computer control:** computer control is released with its run, so later calls no longer fail with `COMPUTER_HOST_BUSY`. (#151127, #147420) Thanks @ylcn91 and @vovarbv.
- **Automations:** cron target and payload validation errors are reported as invalid requests, and Workboard fallback runs stay active until the overall outcome settles. (#169102, #168215, #167574) Thanks @obviyus, @skyzhao1223, and @asikorskiy.
- **Agents API sessions:** saved remote sessions continue with the same session ID across binding upgrades. (#168150)
- **Large Gateways:** large fleets reserve session stores without stack overflows, and process-owning Gateway stops no longer wait on native skills watcher cleanup. (#168354, #168160, #168273) Thanks @609NFT and @obviyus.
- **Updates and recovery:** managed updates settle eligible stale package recovery after a lost or replaced handoff lease database and archive completed receipts before the next preparation; `--dry-run` only reports the planned settlement. (#169038, #167506, #167771) Thanks @mkdelta221 and @waynegault.
- **Legacy update records:** 2026.9.8 package recovery records settle by identity and version after metadata drift, completed-receipt identity drift no longer blocks updates, and public repair exits nonzero with guidance when a journal stays pending. (#169027, #168856, #168388, #168092) Thanks @chedong, @k94118, and @RomneyDa.
- **Update outcomes:** accepted Gateway update handoffs are not reported as failures, recorded successes stay successful with a warning about stopped channels, original failures survive unavailable cleanup reporting, repaired migrations stop producing stale warnings, package verification tolerates clock jumps, and migrated-state failures point to `openclaw update repair`. (#168993, #168870, #169037, #169454, #169004, #168835, #168905) Thanks @sayitfast, @hannesrudolph, and @WG-Mojo.
- **Update memory and webhooks:** update children inherit the managed service's heap limits so Doctor finishes on large agent databases, and official webhook plugins deferred during candidate Doctor keep their listeners, including Teams' historical port 3978. (#168889, #168729, #169035, #168872) Thanks @bluet and @sirius1024.
- **Update runtimes:** updater workers stay on the retained runtime and `openclaw doctor --fix` reclaims retained runtimes when the install path uses a Windows short (8.3) name or different casing, and updates no longer copy unrelated dependencies into the retained runtime. (#169292, #168927) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- **Update diagnostics:** an unsealed original-state capture warning names the affected database, and a candidate config read failure warning includes its reason. (#169282, #169259, #169284, #169261) Thanks @DonnieFi.
- **Codex Ultrafast:** ChatGPT sign-in sessions keep Ultrafast on resumed turns instead of dropping to Fast after the first turn. (#169265, #169264) Thanks @SanderHelgesen.
- **npm-global updates:** the updater runtime keeps only OpenClaw's own dependencies instead of every unrelated package in the global `node_modules`. (#169551, #169373) Thanks @RomneyDa and @holgergruenhagen.
- **Update exit handling:** a completed update whose result reporting fails exits with its warning instead of opening interactive failure triage. (#168587)
- **Doctor maintenance:** Doctor and update repair enter maintenance on a running systemd Gateway even when checking a large state database is slow. (#168161, #168031) Thanks @obviyus and @Tosko4.

This audited record covers the complete v2026.10.5-beta.1..8ed6123845921594f4643c1914e8ceb8cfb42c07 history: 91 in-range PRs + 0 retained seed-only PRs = 91 unique PRs. The generation manifest also supplies direct commits as editorial input; the grouped notes above prioritize user impact.

## 2026.10.2

### Highlights

- **Updates from 2026.10.1:** the first upgrade from stable 2026.10.1 now completes cleanly, successful in-place updates no longer end in errors, and Windows, cloned-filesystem, and private-Node update paths finish instead of stalling or rolling back. (#168849, #169031, #165233, #166530, #168968, #164677, #165257) Thanks @RomneyDa, @jarvisnextgeneration20-lang, and @MrJanvar.
- **Doctor and update recovery:** Doctor no longer stops on residual legacy imports, stale Gateway locks, slow state inspection, memory reindex locks, or allowlists for removed channel accounts, and stale-receipt sessions keep their current data. (#166397, #165355, #165417, #168161, #166517, #167651, #165775) Thanks @coolcoolwcr, @obviyus, @Tosko4, @noelff, @oshunter, @donquiche61, and @RomneyDa.
- **Provider-native compaction:** OpenAI and Anthropic API-key routes now default to provider-native compaction, and compaction recovers when the primary auth profile is cooling down. (#168164, #166459) Thanks @obviyus and @hawkit.
- **Secret redaction:** credentials that cross a chunk boundary in long tool output are now masked, and redaction of large text no longer stalls or overflows the stack while running several times faster. (#161480, #166701, #167943) Thanks @eleqtrizit.
- **Prompt-cache stability:** Anthropic conversation checkpoints, enriched user prompts, tool results, and inter-session provenance stay byte-identical across follow-ups, replays, Gateway restarts, and subagent completions, so cached prefixes keep hitting. (#168042, #167938, #168392, #167898, #169130, #169238) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- **Gateway responsiveness:** Control UI reconnects, model changes with large plugins, dashboard title work, and catalog loading no longer freeze the Gateway or hang new sessions. (#167374, #161267, #162689, #166089, #166376) Thanks @jalehman, @obviyus, @ericcaiwx-star, @cursoragent, @dimonnld, and @dprev.

### Changes

- Defaulted OpenAI and Anthropic API-key routes to provider-native compaction. (#168164) Thanks @obviyus.
- Reported finalized update successes and suppressed channels as warnings instead of failures. (#169037)
- Stopped live npm dist-tag drift from failing already-validated release candidates. (#168836) Thanks @RomneyDa.

### Fixes

- Fixed credential leaks across redaction chunk boundaries and redaction stalls on large tool output. (#161480) Thanks @eleqtrizit.
- Fixed replies lost while an agent finishes starting, streamed Telegram replies vanishing when the replacement message never lands, and Telegram treating local owner rejection as ambiguous delivery. (#168826, #164649, #167470) Thanks @xiaozishan, @jayzhou2309, @obviyus, @jmar5439, and @mgr-nick.
- Fixed Claude CLI sessions showing runtime prompts as user messages, routed CLI prompts appearing on the owner's side of history, lost replies after long streamed turns, and post-turn compaction failing without an Anthropic API key. (#166080, #163521, #153545, #162066) Thanks @Marvinthebored, @Peetiegonzalez, @RomneyDa, @rogeriochaves, @zhangguiping-xydt, @obviyus, @methylester, @llmsommelier, and @ajmtrz.
- Fixed subagent and ACP answers being truncated, superseded child answers delivered by late receipts, and requester turns stopping when completion delivery expires. (#165800, #162843, #166139, #164282) Thanks @yetval, @holgergruenhagen, @zyz619963502zyz, @Yun-0000, @michaeljgood71, @Oldrich333, and @obviyus.

name: CC Switch v4.0.9
body:
# CC Switch v4.0.9

### 4.0 正式版的第五个修复版本

重新梳理了添加供应商的整个流程：表单按填写顺序排列，地址和 Key 之后就是模型列表；点「获取模型列表」后弹窗自动打开，每个模型的上下文窗口、是否支持推理和图片输入都已经查好，勾选后点「应用」就连同参数一起加进列表，同一个弹窗里取消勾选就能移除；字段说明收进「?」，提示会按应用当前是直连、路由还是聚合来显示。另外修复了 Codex 新建线程和自动化在部分上游报错、整个线程无法继续的问题：经路由转成 Chat 协议的 DeepSeek、OpenCode Zen 等报 400，xAI 原生 Responses 报 422。WSL2 里的 Claude Desktop 等连不上本机回环的客户端，现在可以在「设置 → 本地路由」填一个「连接地址」。4.0 完整的更新内容请见 [v4.0 发布说明](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/docs/release-notes/v4.0.4-zh.md)。

**[English →](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/docs/release-notes/v4.0.9-en.md) | [日本語版 →](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/docs/release-notes/v4.0.9-ja.md)**

---

## 重新梳理的供应商添加流程

这一版把添加和编辑供应商的表单从头到尾理了一遍，主要是 Claude Code、Codex 和聚合三种布局。以前模型列表收在高级选项里，排在它所决定的默认模型后面；获取到的模型只能在列表下方逐个添加，加完还要逐个核对自动填好的参数；几乎每个字段下面都有一段灰字，有些提示和你实际所处的模式对不上。现在按填写顺序走一遍：

**1. 地址、Key 和上游格式。** 先选预设或填地址和 Key。选上游格式时，提示按应用当前的模式显示：应用处在直连模式时，如果选的格式需要转换，格式下面会提示这张卡正在直连使用、改成这种格式保存后请求会失败，或者这种格式要先切到路由或聚合才能用。Claude Code 的上游格式选 OpenAI Chat 或 Responses 时，不再显示用不上的认证字段。

**2. 模型列表：获取、挑选、自动填参数。** Codex 的模型列表从高级选项里挪了出来，紧跟在地址和 Key 后面，和聚合布局一样叫「模型列表」。Claude Code 聚合、Codex、OpenCode 和 MiniMax Code 的模型列表现在这样添加模型：

1. 点模型列表上的「获取模型列表」。
2. 获取成功后「选择模型」弹窗自动打开。每个模型旁边已经显示好上下文窗口，以及是否支持推理和图片输入，数值来自同地址的预设，其次按供应商地址查 models.dev，再其次查模型厂商自己的条目。
3. 勾选想要的模型，点「应用」。新模型追加到列表末尾，参数按弹窗里显示的值直接填好，不再弹「已补全……的上下文等参数，请核对」的提示。

同一个弹窗也负责删除：勾选表示「在列表里」，已配置的模型默认勾选，取消勾选后点「应用」就会从列表移除，点「取消」什么都不改。留下的模型保持原来的顺序和设置。已配置但供应商这次没返回的模型，单独列在「不在供应商列表中」一组，也能一并清理。弹窗支持搜索、全选 / 全不选、只看已选，并显示已选数量；获取过一次后按钮变成「选择模型」，再点不会重新获取，需要时在弹窗里点「重新获取」。

**3. 默认模型：列表第一行。** Codex 有模型列表时，第一行就是默认模型，不再单独有一个默认模型输入框；改名或删掉第一行，默认模型跟着变。列表原本为空时，添加模型会自动把当前的默认模型放在第一行，默认模型不会因为加了列表而变掉。没有配置模型列表的卡仍然保留默认模型输入框：这类卡用的是 Codex 自带的 `/model` 菜单，加上列表后菜单里只会剩下列表里的模型。聚合模型列表也去掉了每行的 ★ 和「设为默认模型」，规则同样是第一行即默认。

**4. 子代理（Codex，新增）。** Codex 表单新增「子代理模型」和「子代理推理强度」，对应 `config.toml` 里 `[agents]` 下的 `default_subagent_model` 和 `default_subagent_reasoning_effort`。留空就删掉对应的键，子代理沿用主代理的设置；切换供应商时这两项跟着换，`[agents]` 下的其他设置不动。填的模型不在模型列表里时，表单会提示并可以一键加入：不在列表里的模型，Codex 拿不到它的上下文窗口，经路由转成 Chat / Anthropic 协议时还会被换成默认模型。聚合模式下不写这两项，子代理跟随主模型，以免主代理换到另一家的模型后，子代理又被送回默认供应商。

**5. 高级选项。** 「完整 URL」开关只对端点路径不标准的网关有用，挪进了高级选项；已经打开它的卡，编辑时高级选项会自动展开。User-Agent 和请求覆盖合成一块，统一注明只在路由和聚合模式下生效。

**贯穿整个表单：说明收进「?」。** 字段是什么、什么时候用，放在字段名后面的「?」里；页面上只留需要你注意的后果，比如改了模型列表要重启 Codex、最大输出超过实际上限会报 400。托管账号的卡（Codex、xAI 登录和 Copilot）上，后端本来就不读的字段不再显示；旧版残留字段的提示缩成一句话；Claude Desktop 的模型模式说明改成一句话：供应商提供原生 Claude 模型时用直连，DeepSeek、Kimi 等第三方模型用模型映射。

## 新增

**「设置 → 本地路由」新增「连接地址」。** CC Switch 写进客户端配置的代理地址（包括 Claude Desktop 的网关地址）以前总是按监听地址推导，监听 `0.0.0.0` 时写的是 `127.0.0.1`。WSL2（NAT 模式）里的 Claude Desktop 会话访问不到 Windows 的本机回环，所以一直连不上，把监听地址改成 `0.0.0.0` 也没用。现在把监听地址设为 `0.0.0.0`，再在「连接地址」里填 WSL 能访问到的 Windows 地址，写给客户端的代理地址就会改用它。保存后会直接改写正在走路由的客户端，不用重启路由服务。这个设置只保存在本机，不会随云同步带到其他设备。

**新增预设：** SoruxGPT、IKunCode、RunToken、BotCF、YYLX、TokenFlux、OpenModel。

## 修复

- **Codex 新建线程或跑自动化时，DeepSeek 等上游报 400，整个线程用不了。** Codex 桌面版新建线程时会往历史里插入一条没有对应工具调用的工具结果（create_thread 回执）。经路由把 Responses 转成 Chat 协议时，这类结果以前被当成 `role=tool` 消息发出去，DeepSeek、OpenCode Zen 这类严格的 Chat 上游会拒绝这个线程里的每一次请求。现在这类找不到对应调用的工具结果会改成一条带标记的用户消息，里面的图片照常作为图片发送；有对应调用的工具结果和以前完全一样。
- **Codex 用 xAI 原生 Responses 时报 422，线程无法恢复。** Codex 桌面版插入的回执（新建线程、自动化更新、心跳、跨线程消息）没有 `call_id`，xAI 会以「缺少 `call_id`」拒绝整个请求，而回执一直留在历史里，所以这个线程之后都发不出去。现在只在发往 xAI 时，把这类回执改写成带同样标记的用户消息，保留文字和图片；有 `call_id` 的条目和其他上游都不受影响。
- **Claude Code 的上游格式选 OpenAI Chat 或 Responses 时，路由发出的是 `x-api-key`。** 以前请求头只看 Key 的变量名，用 `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` 的卡会发 `x-api-key`，OpenAI 格式的上游不认。现在 OpenAI 格式一律用 `Authorization: Bearer`，Anthropic 格式仍按变量名决定。
- **Claude Code 聚合模式只用默认供应商的兼容开关。** 选到其他供应商的模型时，可能发出那家不支持的功能而报错。现在按开关的性质合并所有成员的设置：关闭实验性 beta、Artifact、自动模式服务器这类，只要有一家关就关；工具搜索、始终启用 effort、细粒度工具流式这类，所有成员都开才开。额外请求体、思考和窗口相关的开关仍然跟随默认供应商。
- **启动时界面语言不对，打开设置页后才变回来。** 首屏语言读的是浏览器缓存，缓存为空或过期时（比如清过 WebView 数据、把 `~/.cc-switch` 复制到新电脑）会先显示系统语言。现在启动时会读取保存的语言设置并立即应用。
- **macOS 上连不上局域网里的 API 地址。** CC Switch 现在会向 macOS 申请「本地网络」权限。第一次连接局域网地址时系统会弹出授权，这次请求可能仍然失败，点「允许」后重试即可。如果以前点过拒绝，需要到「系统设置 → 隐私与安全性 → 本地网络」里打开 CC Switch。
- **打开供应商编辑面板时页面闪一下。** 编辑面板以前先打开一个加载页再换成内容；现在等内容准备好再打开，保留和新增面板一样的淡入效果。

**其他：** Flatpak 构建文档修正了 `--bundles` 参数的写法，并说明没有签名私钥时怎么跳过更新包。

## 升级说明

**数据库结构没有变化**，仍然是 20。新增预设只影响新添加的供应商。

---

## 致谢

感谢 @NeeYoonc（Codex 线程里找不到对应调用的工具结果不再导致 Chat 上游报 400）、@allenxu09（本地路由的「连接地址」）、@chivopic（macOS 本地网络权限）、@NestorRay（打开编辑面板时的闪烁）、@zydo（Flatpak 构建文档）的贡献。

感谢 @loulanyue 更早提交了同一问题的修复，感谢 @OriyukiAkari 实测确认 xAI 原生 Responses 也有这个问题。感谢 @Z-Eternal、@xulimeng2022、@flame916、@hej56230-commits、@Soliton1912、@gggjjto、@KinJ、@xue-ding-e 报告问题、提供复现信息和帮忙验证。

name: v0.6.7
body:
**ripwire 0.6.7: more complete answers, faster calls, fewer bytes.** Caller rows now name their call sites, `--lego`
walks the whole subclass tree, and `--whereis` labels other branches' definitions with the parser. A warm CLI call costs
faster, and `--whereis` is about three times faster: `--whereis=lego` on this repository takes 4.7 s instead of 13.3 s and returns
18,616 bytes instead of 56,075 (0.6.5 vs 0.6.7, same checkout).

## Read this first: the routing default changed (#381)
An install with no `~/.ripwire/meter.conf` now splits sessions (`arm=auto`): about half get no routing hints and no
SessionStart primer, so the treatment-versus-control comparison has a control group. Put `arm=treatment` in
`~/.ripwire/meter.conf` to keep the old behaviour. Prompts starting with `<channel` or `<agent-message` are now treated
as harness events. Thanks @ahmedibrahim085.

## Complete answers
- `--callers` / `--safe-delete` rows carry `sites_at=`, the call sites as `file:line`, so the first answer holds the lines to edit `--callers=escapeXml` on this repository: the 40 caller rows of its first answer, of 142 callers, carry 79 call lines (0.6.5: none).
- `--lego` lists implementors below a direct one (`via=`, `depth=`). A two-level formatter hierarchy fixture: 5 of 5 implementors (was 2).
- `--whereis` labels another ref's rows by parsing the blob. `--whereis=escapeXml` on this repository: 2 rows, both the declaration (was 60 rows, 54 of them call sites).
- `--for` gives the function a question names its own call-hop row. On 32 `--for` questions over 8 public repos, 8 answers gain it and 23 are byte-identical (+1.4% bytes in total).
- The default map lists directories and entry points it used to cut. tmux `input.c`, `key-bindings.c` and `main` now appear (+7.0% median bytes).
- `--impact` rolls its reach up per file. tmux `--impact=grid_set_cell` names `input.c` and `window-client.c` (was neither).

## Faster
- A warm `--callers` call on a 3,100-file snapshot went from 319 to 269 ms, every answer byte-identical (about 8–10% on this repository against 0.6.5).
- `--whereis` on a checkout with 139 local branches: 12.3 s → 3.7 s; `--whereis=lego` on this repository's 596 refs: 13.3 s → 4.7 s (vs 0.6.5).
- Memory, plainly: `--whereis` now parses other branches' files to tell definitions from call sites, so its peak is about 1.0 GB, up from 0.6 GB in 0.6.5 (`--whereis=lego`, 596 refs). Within this release it was cut from 1.42 GB by reading back only the files it parses.

## Smaller answers, same rows
- `--whereis=lego`: 56,075 → 18,616 B against 0.6.5 (129,314 B mid-cycle), every row kept. A long line's `t=` is a 200-byte preview, and `next=` replays it whole.
- `--expand` / `--outline` drop the ride-along map once every definition is served. `--expand=subtokens`: 26,791 → 5,317 B.
- `--grep=split-window` on tmux: 16,108 → 5,453 B, with the defining line first.
- A clean-tree `--quality-delta` prints its verdict, not its acks: 14,594 → 978 B on this repository.

## Honest answers
- A C++ call named like a standard member (`empty`, `size`, `find`, …) binds no in-tree namesake unless a rule ties its receiver to one. On this repository's map, top-20 rows carrying such a name: 14 → 0.
- A call bound by name alone keeps its rows and says so (`via="name"`), and typed receivers resolve. Cost: +2.04% bytes over 210 calls on eight public repositories.
- The cross-branch verbs, `--whereis` and the git history walk refuse or disclose when git could not be read. They no longer answer `hits="0"` or a silent empty churn.
- A compact `--for` answer fits an explicit `--token-budget` wherever the full dialect does, and says why where it cannot.
- `--seams` no longer reports doc-to-doc links as untested seams. They are counted in `doc_links=` (53 on this repository).

## Imports and languages
- JS/TS and Go import edges come from the shared `@import.path` capture (#358), with output byte-identical. The C-family slice is from @lennix1337 (#368).
- Ruby calls resolve by Ruby's method lookup: mixins, class objects, `self`, built receivers, RSpec targets and Rails callbacks (#373, #325, #338, thanks @andriytyurnikov).
- A Rails `db/schema.rb` renders its columns as definitions (#339, thanks @mpapis).

## MCP and paging
- `--for` / `--pack-task` under a budget take a resumable `--limit`/`--offset` window, and MCP `explore` gains `limit`/`offset` (#362, thanks @pt-act; issue #294).
- A memory guard on every root gives a disclosed partial answer instead of unbounded growth (#350, thanks @KilimcininKorOglu).

## Fixed before release
- C++: a call on an element of a standard container whose element type is in-tree (`m[k].empty()`, `.at()`, `.front()`, `.back()`) keeps its by-name edge instead of being declined as a standard member (ninja `ParseRule`'s `bindings_["rspfile"].empty()`).
- `--impact` with a name that matches more than one definition: a file row whose symbols were matched by name alone says so (`via="name"` / `by_name=`), instead of reading as a proven dependant.

## Thanks
Code: @andriytyurnikov, @lennix1337, @mpapis, @pt-act, @llvm-x86 (#342/#351: the Linux sanitizer path builds again).
Reports: @ahmedibrahim085 (#381), @KilimcininKorOglu (#350), @toasterbook88 (#353, `--scan-skills` net-exfil grading).
Want to help? `CONTRIBUTING.md` now maps each feature family to its one shared handler, with slices you can claim.

## Versions and caches
The parser version is now 167 and the cache version 31, so caches and quality snapshots from earlier builds are rebuilt once on first run.

Full notes: [CHANGELOG.md, section 0.6.7](https://github.com/redhat-et/ripwire/blob/v0.6.7/CHANGELOG.md).

name: v0.95.0
body:
### Highlights

- OpenCode Go models, including grok-4.7 and gpt-6-luna, now route over the Responses API
- Hooks expose turn-end token usage, and turn_start/turn_end now fire for one-shot jcode run turns
- /agents supports per-session worker model overrides

### Improvements

- /resume can open scoped to the current project when display.resume_project_scope is enabled
- Swarm gains a stalled-worker watchdog, and headless run --socket sessions can join swarms
- The macOS menu bar helper uses a stable signing identity, draws the streaming icon green, and can be turned off with [menubar] enabled = false
- Inline images fit their reserved box and the info widget hugs its content
- Command risk assessment now inspects commands inside $(...), backticks, and heredocs
- SDK-launched private instances no longer auto-update mid-session and give shorter, more accurate connect errors

### Fixes

- Ctrl/Alt/Cmd shortcuts work on the Korean 2-Set input source
- The terminal keyboard protocol and TUI modes are restored when jcode exits on a signal
- Rate-limit and provider reconnect auto-resumes are bounded instead of retrying indefinitely
- OpenAI streams recover faster from stalls and OAuth token refresh no longer hangs
- Tool calls emitted as DSML/invoke markup text are recovered instead of lost
- Kimi reasoning via OpenRouter no longer loses text from non-cumulative snapshots
- Resumed sessions heal a stale credential route so swarm workers inherit the live one

name: v0.9.87
body:
## 0.9.87 (2026-10-12)

Eighteen community pull requests: language-extraction fixes (PHP, C#, Python, TypeScript, Julia), retrieval and watch hardening, and skill/benchmark correctness.

- Fix: **PHP** a `Class::method()` static call now resolves to the called method rather than binding to the class node, and no longer stalls at INFERRED confidence for a same-namespace call that needs no `use` import. `self`/`static`/`parent` and lowercase class receivers route through the PHP resolver, fail-closed on any ambiguous or off-corpus receiver (#3872, #3874, thanks @rikurunico).
- Fix: **C#** nested and generic `partial` types now merge by their full type path (`Outer\`1.Inner`), so a two-file nested partial is unified while `Foo` and `Foo<T>` stay distinct; a cross-file unqualified call binds to the caller's own merged type when it is the single own-type candidate, and a sourceless placeholder base is dropped when a real same-named base exists on the partial (#4363, #4364, thanks @JensD-git). (The AST cache schema is bumped, so the first build after upgrading re-extracts.)
- Feature: **Python** a read of a `@property` (`obj.prop`, including `x.prop += v`) now links to the property's getter, instead of being dropped as a bare attribute access (#4337, thanks @rohit-jsfreaky). (The AST cache schema is bumped, so the first build after upgrading re-extracts.)
- Fix: **TypeScript** a public call `c.name()` reaches a `#name`-labeled node only when the class declares a public `name`, and a public call keeps its edge when `foo` and `#foo` share one node (#4298, thanks @rohit-jsfreaky).
- Fix: **Julia** parametric and module-qualified functor (callable-struct) types are named by their type rather than the variable, and never fall back to the variable binding (#4351, thanks @ayarodionov).
- Fix: **C#** a `var` is typed from the called method's return type, so downstream member calls on it resolve (#4266, #4268, thanks @Mpasha17).
- Fix: `graphify affected <PR>` now scopes graph impact to the requested PR instead of the repository default branch, and PR default-branch detection is isolated under test (#3829, thanks @hopstreax).
- Fix: `update` refuses to drop a saved semantic node id when the node total grows (treating it as an incomplete re-extract), while still letting a removed import stub go; `export` keeps an integer node id that is still in the graph (#4115, thanks @SrijanSriv).
- Fix: the MCP `query_graph` seed order no longer lets a weak match on an early-alphabet term lead a specific term's exact match: the per-term guaranteed seeds (#1445) are ordered by match strength (#4357, #4358, thanks @devkancheti4-design).
- Fix: the update skill stamps `_origin` on the semantic tier so an AST-only `update` cannot delete semantic nodes it did not re-extract (#2843, #3110, thanks @abhay-codes07).
- Feature: a project can declare what an ambiguous extension (`.inc`, `.h`, TS-family) means via `language.<ext>=<language|.ext>` lines in `.graphifyrc`; the declaration flows through classification, extractor selection, imports, watch, and the AST cache, and default detection is byte-for-byte unchanged when absent (#2961, #3789, thanks @andrebrait and @abhay-codes07).
- Fix: the hook's soft read/search nudge is bounded per session instead of firing on every matching file (#3435, #3443, thanks @L4XB).
- Fix: the update skill prints a short summary of the incremental step and leaves the full result in `.graphify_incremental.json`, instead of dumping every file path into the agent context (#3952, thanks @mdshzb04).
- Fix: **skillgen** Step 3 Part A now passes `root=` to `extract()`, so adapting the snippet to a relocated cache (`--out`) no longer renames every code node and blinds the node-count shrink guard (#3727, #3955, thanks @jnrod03-rgb).
- Fix: **watch** a full-corpus rebuild is no longer silently dropped when the rebuild lock is busy; it is queued (superseding queued incremental paths) and drained after the in-flight rebuild, and the "changes queued" log only prints when something was actually queued (#4274, #4276, thanks @smngvlkz).
- Fix: the benchmark now counts the tokens of the answer `query_graph` actually returns (calling the real budgeted query path) instead of a separate unbudgeted reimplementation (#4347, #4348, thanks @rohit-jsfreaky).
- Feature: **graph.html** gains a light/dark/system theme toggle; the dark default renders byte-identically to before (#3894, #4300, thanks @Mpasha17).
- Fix: labeling now honors the Claude CLI model environment variable (`GRAPHIFY_CLAUDE_CLI_MODEL`), matching the extraction path, so labeling no longer silently falls back to the session default model (#3846, #3876, thanks @oleksii-tumanov).

name: v0.9.86
body:
Eighteen community pull requests: language-extraction fixes, safety and determinism hardening, and CLI/query ergonomics.

- Safety: `graphify uninstall --purge` now refuses to delete the project (or home, or a filesystem root) when `GRAPHIFY_OUT` is empty or `.`, instead of silently removing the working tree (#4329, thanks @Hassannzidan).
- Fix: **Julia** now extracts return-typed, qualified (`Base.show`), operator (`Base.:+`) and functor (callable-struct) methods, and resolves broadcast (`f.(xs)`) and pipe (`x |> f`) calls (#4310, thanks @ayarodionov).
- Fix: **Rust** grouped `use` declarations (`use a::{b, c::d}`) now expand into one import binding per name, instead of a single edge to the common prefix (#4135, thanks @krishhgg). (The AST cache schema is bumped, so the first build after upgrading re-extracts.)
- Fix: **Scala 3** `class Foo derives Bar` now links the class to each derived typeclass (#2048, #4173, thanks @Mpasha17).
- Fix: **Codex** semantic chunks are no longer clobbered by the shared B3 merge (each chunk is written to its own file, matching the other hosts), so semantic nodes/edges survive (#4311, #4312, thanks @vibhanshu-mishra).
- Fix: `affected <Symbol>` now also walks callers of the supertype member that an overriding method overrides, so a change to an override surfaces users of the base contract (#4330, #4331, thanks @rohit-jsfreaky).
- Fix: dedup keeps combining marks in label normalization, so distinct Indic-script words no longer collapse to one node (#4317, #4318, thanks @Suraj370).
- Fix: dedup ranks a relative `source_file` against the scan root rather than the CWD, so building from a subdirectory no longer strands an extension-renamed node's edges on the survivor (#4281, #4326, thanks @Deepjyoti-Sarmah).
- Fix: the global (cross-repo) graph preserves stored edge direction on `global add`, so `path` and other direction-aware readers no longer follow reversed arcs (#4066, #4138, thanks @e4c5).
- Fix: graphify now respects git's global ignore file (`core.excludesFile`), with git-faithful precedence and `~`/XDG expansion (#4335, #4339, thanks @smngvlkz).
- Fix: null token counts from a backend are coerced to 0 across all backends, instead of crashing a chunk with a `TypeError` (#4325, #4340, thanks @rtmalikian).
- Feature: built-in Ollama requests accept a sampling seed for reproducible extraction (#4168, thanks @oleksii-tumanov).
- Fix: `explain` refuses a name carried by several nodes of one file (ambiguous within a file) instead of silently picking one (#4320, thanks @alexwrite).
- Fix: lookups now return distinct exit codes — 0 for an answer, 3 for an ambiguous name, 4 for a missing one — so scripts can tell a miss from a hit (#4321, thanks @alexwrite).
- Fix: `explain`/`query` tell you how to get the full answer (and add `explain --all`) when the output is truncated to the token budget (#4323, thanks @alexwrite).
- Change: a committed `graph.json` is now written as one line of compact JSON, so re-running a build produces a `+1/-1` diff instead of a large whitespace churn (#3413, #4319, thanks @andrebrait).
- Docs: the always-on guidance explains that large `graph.json` diffs in pull requests are expected (#4324, thanks @andrebrait), and the README distinguishes local CLI skill guidance from MCP instructions (#3925, #4292, thanks @Tivonsico).
